meta.name: design-doctrine
meta.description: The house rules for ANY design or UI work - the verification protocol (run the gate, never claim a number), the absolute no-emoji rule, token by intent, one shared theme, the eight states, one thing leads, and output completeness. Load this FIRST whenever building, reviewing, or theming a screen, component, or token set. Installed as a plugin, this skill carries what CLAUDE.md carries in the repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面按统一设计规范落地,每个组件都过检查再交付
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用一套统一规范做界面并逐项验收
copy.tagline_en: Build screens under one shared design standard and verify every component
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you ship UI that must follow one house design standard, verified item by item

howto.what: Claude 在做任何界面、组件或主题设计前先读这套规则:不用 emoji;颜色、间距走 token 并按意图选;每个可交互元素配八种状态;不报没实测过的数字,而是跑验证脚本核对暗色、hover、焦点和响应式;只交付完整文件,不留占位符。
howto.when: 当你构建、评审或给界面、组件、设计令牌做主题时,它在设计工作开始前先加载规则文件;作为插件安装时,它承载仓库 CLAUDE.md 里的常驻要求。

say.text: 帮我做这个按钮,记得把八种状态都写上
跑一下验证脚本,告诉我真实的通过数
say.note: 执行 accuracy_report 并报真实 N/N

say.text: 给这个页面做暗色主题,颜色统一走 token
say.note: 只从 tokens 取色,不写死 hex

howto.what_en: Before any UI, component, or theme work, Claude loads these rules: no emoji; tokens by intent for colour and spacing; eight states per interactive element; only measured numbers from the gate scripts; complete files, no placeholders.
howto.when_en: When you build, review, or theme a screen, component, or token set, it loads first, before any design work; as a plugin it carries the repo's always-on brief.

say_en.text: Build this button for me and include all eight states.
say_en.note: Adds default, hover, focus, active and more.

say_en.text: Run the verification scripts and tell me the real pass count.
Give this page a dark theme, colours only from tokens.
say_en.note: No hardcoded hex, one shared theme.
